test: Friedman chi-square approximation with within-seed blocks
null_and_assumptions: Exchangeability of model labels within independent seed blocks under the global null. A rejection establishes a distributional/rank difference; a median or location-only interpretation needs comparable distribution shapes. These are seed blocks, not independently sampled dates or markets.
scope: Post-execution exploratory supplement; initialization uncertainty conditional on the same 60 historical dates and frozen recipes. Not preregistered, not independent temporal confirmation.
